title: OpenAI Admin API key (sk-admin-): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: one identifier character before the prefix, so the key is embedded in a longer token and boundary: sk-admin_ in place of the sk-admin- delimiter. Twin of "OpenAI Admin API key (sk-admin-): must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of openai-admin-api-key-python-sdk: boundary: sk-admin_ in place of the sk-admin- delimiter. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
